|notes=* The Premiere Limited card prints “Owen Lars, Beru Lars and Luke deploy -1 here.” on its Light Side, as strangewayes' 600 dpi scan shows ([[:File:Premiere-L-tatooinelarsmoisturefarm-hires.webp]]). The Premiere Two-Player Game card ([[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (Two-Player)]]) prints the same words; Premiere Unlimited ([[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (Unlimited)]], April 1996) removed Owen Lars.<ref name="encyc-35">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=35 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 35 (Premiere Unlimited, “Revisions”: “Tatooine: Lars’ Moisture Farm (removed Owen Lars from game text)”). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> Unlimited corrected Premiere Limited cards the same way elsewhere: strangewayes' Limited [[Electrobinoculars]] shows the uncorrected deploy and use costs that p. 35 says Unlimited fixed.<ref name="encyc-35" /> (Page 46 of the same encyclopedia lists the Two-Player card as a misprint whose corrected version reads “Beru Lars and Luke”; that compares it with the white-border Unlimited card.)
* The black border on strangewayes' scans is a digital fill: it is the same on every one of his files, including the Two-Player premium cards that were printed white-bordered. So the border alone does not prove this is a Limited copy rather than a Two-Player one. The text matches Encyclopedia p. 35, but no independent photo of a Limited copy has been found.{{Mystery|question=Is there a photo of a Premiere Limited (black border) Lars' Moisture Farm showing Owen Lars in its game text|type=card}}
* Decipher's own card-list image ([[:File:Premiere-L-tatooinelarsmoisturefarm-decipher-archive.gif]]) shows the later wording without Owen Lars, so it is not a picture of the Premiere Limited printing; the picture above is strangewayes' scan, the only image of this printing's wording.
* Errata: Decipher's [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (Decipher Errata 1998)]] (drops Owen Lars) and the Players Committee's [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] · [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] · [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (PC Errata 2018 E card)]].
